ns2:course.label: Advanced Research in Psych
ns2:course.description: Supervised independent investigation of special topics in psychology; requires a written report with a final copy submitted for departmental records. No graduate credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 9 hours. Prerequisite: Ten hours of psychology or cognate area, or written consent of instructor.
